title: Run final branch-scope compatibility and verification audit
description: After every branch-scoped implementation, test, documentation, and skill task is complete, audit the combined repository for contract drift and apply only integration fixes required by the agreed design. Reconcile cleanly with the previously completed retained-handoff initiative: task/handoff JSON additions, claim-attached output, exports, shared stores, and both skills must continue working. Verify existing tracked legacy .wtp history is untouched; old stores and legacy CLI flags still work; every named branch uses first-8-hex SHA-256 scoped IDs/indexes; detached/non-Git stays global; foreign tasks are never automatic but explicit start works; branch rename and hash-collision errors are documented. Run gofmt validation, go test ./..., go vet ./..., relevant skill validators, and ./scripts/verify.sh commit. Record concrete failures and pause instead of weakening tests, changing product decisions, or performing migrations.
